en.hook: $0.65 a mile for Class A OTR drivers
en.body: Class A over-the-road driving at $0.65 per mile. You need to be 23+ to apply. Send us your info and talk to our recruiters.

en.body: Over-the-road means long runs and miles on the road. You hold a Class A, you are 23+, and every mile pays $0.65.

es.hook: $0.65 por milla en OTR, Clase A

en.body: Here it is straight: Class A license, over-the-road freight, $0.65 per mile. You need to be 23+. Apply and we talk it through.
